name: Dropzone
whenToUse: Uploading one or several files where dragging from the desktop is common: documents, media, imports.
Showing what’s staged (`files`), uploading (`loading`) and done (`successFile`) in one place.

whenNotToUse.text: A single file in a form

anatomy.description: also a button — click or Enter opens the picker.

do.caption: Formats and size limit up front; the accept filter matches the hint.
do.example: {}} />

dont.caption: No limits shown — people find them out from a failed upload.

a11y: Name it with `aria-label` (“Upload documents”); it’s a button, so keyboard users never need to drag.
Errors are announced and stay visible next to the area; per-file errors sit on the file.
Rejected files go to `onReject` — tell people which ones and why.

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted types, same syntax as <input accept> (".pdf,image/*"). Applied to dropped files too, not only the picker.

props.name: loading
props.description: Zone shows a spinner + "Uploading…" and becomes non-interactive. Takes priority over error/successFile while true.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called with dropped files that don't match `accept` (they are not passed to onFiles). Use it to show an error.

props.name: successFile
props.description: Replaces the drag/or/Browse content with a single-file success confirmation (checkmark, name, upload date) — for single-file flows like a resume upload. Ignored while `error` is set.
